description: Angular component for embedding and managing images within the Thingsboard UI, including public status updates and code generation for embedding images in HTML and Angular templates.

classes.name: EmbedImageDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for embedding images, allowing public status toggling and generating embed code.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up subscription to public status changes if not readonly.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning the image if changed, or null.

methods.name: embedToHtmlCode
methods.description: Generates HTML embed code for the image.

methods.name: embedToAngularTemplateCode
methods.description: Generates Angular template code for the image.

methods.name: updateImagePublicStatus
methods.description: Updates the public status of the image via ImageService.
